/** the key of a helper slot `T[k]` / `T.k` read through `alias` (the table the summarised function is stored in) */
function slotKey(e: A.Expr, alias: Binding | null, sc: ScopeInfo): number | string | undefined {
  if (!alias) return undefined;
  const u = unparen(e);
  if (u.type === 'MemberExpr') { const o = unparen(u.obj); return o.type === 'NameExpr' && sc.refOf.get(o) === alias ? u.name : undefined; }
  if (u.type !== 'IndexExpr') return undefined;
  const o = unparen(u.obj);
  if (o.type !== 'NameExpr' || sc.refOf.get(o) !== alias) return undefined;
  const i = unparen(u.index);
  return i.type === 'NumberLit' || i.type === 'StringLit' ? i.value : undefined;
}

/** metavariables __a<i> in evaluation (left-to-right) order */
const metaOrder = (e: unknown): string[] => {
  const seq: string[] = [];
  const visit = (x: unknown): void => {
    if (Array.isArray(x)) { x.forEach(visit); return; }
    if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return;
    const n = x as { type?: unknown; name?: unknown };
    if (n.type === 'NameExpr' && typeof n.name === 'string' && /^__a\d+$/.test(n.name)) { seq.push(n.name); return; }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(x)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(v);
  };
  visit(e);
  return seq;
};

interface HelperSummary { to: string; pure: boolean; guard: string | null; }
const FAIL = Symbol('fail');
const pathExpr = (p: string): A.Expr => (parse('return ' + p).chunk.body[0] as A.ReturnStat).args[0];
const clone = <T>(x: T): T => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) as T;

/** Semantic summary of a small helper function:
 *     function(p…)  [p = p or <d> …]  return E  end
 *  or the same with a guarded alternative implementation through another slot of its own table
 *     if C then return T[j](…) else return E end          (C and the arguments: no calls)
 *  — e.g. an unpack that switches to a chunked version for huge ranges. E may use the parameters, globals,
 *  never-reassigned locals bound to global paths and library slots of the same table (resolved through the dump).
 *  Returns E with the parameters as metavariables __a<i> and their defaults inlined (`__a2 or 1`); `pure` marks
 *  summaries that reorder, duplicate or drop arguments — their rules only match side-effect-free arguments. */
function summarize(f: A.FunctionExpr, sc: ScopeInfo, alias: Binding | null, libOf: (k: number | string) => A.Expr | null): HelperSummary | null {
  if (f.vararg) return null;
  const param = (e: A.Expr): number => {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u.type !== 'NameExpr') return -1;
    const b: Binding | undefined = sc.refOf.get(u);
    return b && b.decl === f && b.kind === 'param' ? b.index : -1;
  };
  const body = f.body.slice();
  const defaults: Array<[number, A.Expr]> = [];
  while (body.length && body[0].type === 'AssignStat') {
    const s = body[0] as A.AssignStat;
    if (s.op || s.targets.length !== 1 || s.values.length !== 1) break;
    const i = param(s.targets[0]);
    const v = unparen(s.values[0]);
    if (i < 0 || defaults.some(d => d[0] === i) || v.type !== 'BinExpr' || v.op !== 'or' || param(v.left) !== i || !sideEffectFree(v.right)) break;
    defaults.push([i, v.right]);
    body.shift();
  }
  const ret1 = (ss: A.Stat[] | undefined): A.Expr | null =>
    ss && ss.length === 1 && ss[0].type === 'ReturnStat' && (ss[0] as A.ReturnStat).args.length === 1 ? (ss[0] as A.ReturnStat).args[0] : null;
  let alts: Array<[A.Expr, A.Expr | null]> = [];
  let guard: A.Expr | null = null;
  const r0 = ret1(body);
  if (r0) alts = [[r0, null]];
  else if (body.length && body.length <= 2 && body[0].type === 'IfStat') {
    const s = body[0] as A.IfStat;
    const a = s.clauses.length === 1 ? ret1(s.clauses[0].body) : null;
    const b = body.length === 1 ? ret1(s.elseBody) : (s.elseBody && s.elseBody.length ? null : ret1(body.slice(1)));
    if (a && b && sideEffectFree(s.clauses[0].cond)) { guard = s.clauses[0].cond; alts = [[b, a], [a, b]]; }
  }
  const defs = new Map<number, unknown>();
  const conv = (e: unknown): unknown => {
    if (Array.isArray(e)) { const r = e.map(conv); return r.includes(FAIL) ? FAIL : r; }
    if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') return e;
    const n = e as A.Expr;
    if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr' || n.type === 'VarargLit') return FAIL;
    if (n.type === 'NameExpr') {
      const b: Binding | undefined = sc.refOf.get(n);
      if (!b || b.kind === 'global') return { type: 'NameExpr', name: n.name };
      if (b.decl === f && b.kind === 'param') {
        const m = { type: 'NameExpr', name: '__a' + b.index };
        const d = defs.get(b.index);
        return d ? { type: 'ParenExpr', expr: { type: 'BinExpr', op: 'or', left: m, right: clone(d) } } : m;
      }
      if (b.kind === 'local' && b.writes === 0 && b.init && !b.initMulti && globalPath(b.init, sc)) {
        const i = unparen(b.init);
        return conv(i.type === 'BinExpr' ? { type: 'ParenExpr', expr: i } : i);
      }
      return FAIL;
    }
    if (n.type === 'IndexExpr' || n.type === 'MemberExpr') {
      const k = slotKey(n, alias, sc);
      if (k !== undefined) return libOf(k) ?? FAIL;
    }
    const o: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(e)) {
      if (k === 'loc') continue;
      const c = conv(v);
      if (c === FAIL) return FAIL;
      o[k] = c;
    }
    if (o.type === 'CallExpr' && Array.isArray(o.args))
      o.args = o.args.map((a: { type?: string; expr?: { type?: string } }) => (a && a.type === 'ParenExpr' && a.expr && a.expr.type === 'BinExpr' ? a.expr : a));
    return o;
  };
  for (const [i, d] of defaults) { const c = conv(d); if (c === FAIL) return null; defs.set(i, c); }
  for (const [res, alt] of alts) {
    if (alt) {
      const u = unparen(alt);
      if (u.type !== 'CallExpr' || slotKey(u.callee, alias, sc) === undefined || !sideEffectFree(u.args)) continue;
    }
    const to = conv(res);
    if (to === FAIL || !to || typeof to !== 'object') continue;
    const order = metaOrder(to);
    const pure = order.length !== f.params.length || order.some((s, i) => s !== '__a' + i);
    return { to: printExpr(to as A.Expr), pure, guard: guard ? printExpr(guard) : null };
  }
  return null;
}

export interface WrapperRules { rules: RewriteRule[]; notes: string[]; }

/** Rewrite rules that inline the helper-table slots holding small helper functions (see summarize; needs a dump
 *  with $at source offsets, i.e. one made by vm_boot_dump). */
export function helperWrapperRules(src: string, dumpJson: unknown, helper: { name: string; path: string }): WrapperRules {
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const sc = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const fns = new Map<number, A.FunctionExpr>();
  const storedIn = new Map<A.FunctionExpr, Binding>();   // `T[k] = function … end` → T (the helper table in that scope)
  walk(chunk, (n: any) => {
    if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr' && n.loc) fns.set(n.loc.start, n);
    if (n.type !== 'AssignStat' || n.op) return;
    n.values.forEach((v: any, i: number) => {
      const t = n.targets[i];
      if (!v || v.type !== 'FunctionExpr' || !t || (t.type !== 'IndexExpr' && t.type !== 'MemberExpr')) return;
      const o = unparen(t.obj);
      const b: Binding | undefined = o.type === 'NameExpr' ? sc.refOf.get(o) : undefined;
      if (b && b.kind !== 'global' && b.writes === 0) storedIn.set(v, b);
    });
  });
  const dump = new LuaDump(dumpJson);
  let h: unknown = dump.root;
  for (const p of helper.path.split(/[./]/).filter(Boolean)) h = dump.get(h, /^\d+$/.test(p) ? Number(p) : p);
  if (!dump.isTable(h)) return { rules: [], notes: [`helper table path '${helper.path}' not found in the dump`] };
  const libOf = (key: number | string): A.Expr | null => {
    const d = dump.deref(dump.get(h, key)) as { $fn?: unknown; $at?: unknown } | null;
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || typeof d.$fn !== 'string' || d.$at !== undefined || !LIB.test(d.$fn)) return null;
    return pathExpr(d.$fn);
  };
  const keyTexts = (k: unknown): string[] =>
    typeof k === 'number' ? [`[${numRaw(k)}]`] : typeof k === 'string' ? (/^[A-Za-z_]\w*$/.test(k) ? ['.' + k, `[${JSON.stringify(k)}]`] : [`[${JSON.stringify(k)}]`]) : [];
  const rules: RewriteRule[] = [];
  const shown: string[] = [];
  let tagged = 0;
  for (const [k, v] of dump.entries(h)) {
    const d = dump.deref(v) as { $fn?: unknown; $at?: unknown } | null;
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || typeof d.$fn !== 'string' || typeof d.$at !== 'number') continue;
    tagged++;
    const f = fns.get(d.$at);
    if (!f) continue;
    const s = summarize(f, sc, storedIn.get(f) ?? null, libOf);
    if (!s) continue;
    const args = f.params.map((_, i) => '__a' + i).join(', ');
    const kts = keyTexts(k);
    for (const kt of kts) rules.push(s.pure ? { from: `${helper.name}${kt}(${args})`, to: s.to, pure: true } : { from: `${helper.name}${kt}(${args})`, to: s.to });
    if (kts.length) shown.push(`${helper.name}${kts[0]}(${args}) → ${s.to}${s.guard ? ` [its alternative implementation for ${s.guard} taken as equivalent]` : ''}`);
  }
  const notes: string[] = [];
  if (shown.length) notes.push(`helper table ${helper.name}: ${shown.length} helper function slot(s) summarised and inlined — ${shown.slice(0, 6).join('; ')}${shown.length > 6 ? '; …' : ''}${rules.some(r => r.pure) ? ' (rules that reorder / duplicate arguments only fire on side-effect-free arguments)' : ''}`);
  else if (!tagged) notes.push(`helper table ${helper.name}: the dump has no function source offsets ($at) — make it with vm_boot_dump to inline helper function slots`);
  else notes.push(`helper table ${helper.name}: none of its ${tagged} Lua function slot(s) is a small wrapper — they stay calls`);
  return { rules, notes };
}

Что сделано
vm_boot_dump, новый универсальный тул. Сам находит по структуре функцию, которая собирает замыкания VM, портирует загрузчик в Python и останавливается в момент создания VM. На таргете работает около 1 с, прото полностью совпадает с ручным дампом из прошлых сессий, хелпер-таблица arg361 находится автоматически. На хосте PRISM нужен python3; с run:false тул просто отдаёт программу.
vm_lift, тоже новый: всё в один клик. При необходимости чистит скрипт, снимает дамп, девиртуализирует и структурирует все прото и сохраняет результат отдельным скриптом.
Автоматический разбор хелпер-функций вместо захардкоженного правила для unpack. Тул сам вывел arg361[25](a, b, c) → table.unpack(b, c or 1, a or #b). Непрозрачных вызовов было 104, стало 0.
Защита от ошибок при перезаписи. Правила, которые переставляют или дублируют аргументы, теперь применяются только к аргументам без побочных эффектов.

import re, subprocess, sys, os
STEPS=[1791,1792,1802,1810,1812,1815,1825,1826,1827,1831,1832,1834,1840,1843,1845,1846,1847,1848,1873,1879,1886,1887,1888,1889,1908,1910,1911,1924,1925,1926,1927,1928,1929,1930,1931,1934,1944,1945,1946,1948,1951,1953,1956,1957,2011]
start=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0
only=set(int(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split(',')) if len(sys.argv)>2 else None
def res(cwd,p): return p if p.startswith('/') else os.path.normpath(os.path.join(cwd,p))
for n in STEPS:
    if n<start or (only and n not in only): continue
    cmd=open(f'replay/{n:04d}.sh').read(); lines=cmd.split('\n'); i=0; cwd='/data/prism'; acts=[]
    while i<len(lines):
        ln=lines[i]
        m=re.search(r"<<\s*['\"]?(\w+)['\"]?",ln)
        pre=ln[:m.start()] if m else ln
        for cd in re.finditer(r"(?:^|&&|;|\()\s*cd\s+([^\s;&|)]+)",pre): cwd=res(cwd,cd.group(1))
        if m:
            tag=m.group(1); body=[]; i+=1
            while i<len(lines) and lines[i]!=tag: body.append(lines[i]); i+=1
            i+=1; text='\n'.join(body)+'\n'
            seg=re.split(r'&&|;',pre)[-1].strip()
            if re.match(r'python3?(\s+-)?\s*$',seg):
                r=subprocess.run(['python3','-'],input=text,cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True)
                out=(r.stdout+r.stderr).strip()
                acts.append(('py',r.returncode,out[-600:]))
                if r.returncode!=0:
                    print(f'!! step {n} python FAILED in {cwd}:\n{out[-1500:]}'); sys.exit(1)
            else:
                cm=re.match(r'cat\s*>\s*(\S+)\s*$',seg)
                if cm:
                    p=res(cwd,cm.group(1)); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True); open(p,'w').write(text); acts.append(('cat',0,p))
                else: acts.append(('skip-heredoc',0,seg[:80]))
            continue
        i+=1
    print(f'ok {n}: '+' | '.join(f'{a}:{c}:{o[:160]!r}' for a,c,o in acts))

p='passes/constflow.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old="""const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };"""
new="""const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };

/** integer arithmetic that gives the same result in Lua 5.1-5.4 and Luau (no floats, no -0, no overflow) */
export function arithInt(op: string, a: number, b: number): number | null {
  let r: number;
  const small = Math.abs(a) <= 2 ** 31 && Math.abs(b) <= 2 ** 31;
  switch (op) {
    case '+': r = a + b; break;
    case '-': r = a - b; break;
    case '*': r = a * b; break;
    case '//': if (b === 0 || !small) return null; r = Math.floor(a / b); break;
    case '%': if (b === 0 || !small) return null; r = a - Math.floor(a / b) * b; break;
    default: return null;
  }
  return Number.isSafeInteger(r) && !Object.is(r, -0) ? r : null;
}
/** value of an integer-literal arithmetic expression (`3`, `-2`, `0x10`, `(1 + 1) * 4`); floats are left alone */
export function intOf(e: A.Expr, depth = 0): number | null {
  const u = unparen(e);
  if (!u || depth > 16) return null;
  switch (u.type) {
    case 'NumberLit': return Number.isSafeInteger(u.value) && !Object.is(u.value, -0) && (!u.raw || /^(?:\\d+|0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+)$/.test(u.raw.replace(/_/g, ''))) ? u.value : null;
    case 'UnExpr': { if (u.op !== '-') return null; const v = intOf(u.expr, depth + 1); return v === null || v === 0 ? null : -v; }
    case 'BinExpr': { const a = intOf(u.left, depth + 1); if (a === null) return null; const b = intOf(u.right, depth + 1); return b === null ? null : arithInt(u.op, a, b); }
  }
  return null;
}
const intExpr = (r: number): A.Expr => r < 0
  ? { type: 'UnExpr', op: '-', expr: { type: 'NumberLit', value: -r, raw: String(-r) } } as A.Expr
  : { type: 'NumberLit', value: r, raw: String(r) } as A.Expr;"""
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new,1)
# valOf: fold literal-only integer arithmetic (counters of unrolled loops: i = i + 1 after i = 3 -> 4)
old="""      case 'UnExpr': { const v = unparen(u.expr); if (u.op === '-' && v.type === 'NumberLit' && Number.isFinite(v.value)) return { key: 'n:' + String(-v.value), expr: u }; return null; }"""
new="""      case 'UnExpr': { const v = unparen(u.expr); if (u.op === '-' && v.type === 'NumberLit' && Number.isFinite(v.value)) return { key: 'n:' + String(-v.value), expr: u }; const r = intOf(u); return r === null ? null : { key: 'n:' + String(r), expr: intExpr(r) }; }
      case 'BinExpr': { const r = intOf(u); return r === null ? null : { key: 'n:' + String(r), expr: intExpr(r) }; }"""
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new,1)
# compound assignment on a tracked integer counter: i += 1
old="""          if (s.op) return null;
          if (q < s.values.length)"""
new="""          if (s.op) {
            if (q !== 0 || s.targets.length !== 1 || s.values.length !== 1) return null;
            const b = tb[0], cv = b ? env.get(b) : undefined;
            if (!cv || cv.src) return null;
            const a = intOf(cv.expr), c = intOf(s.values[0]);
            const r = a === null || c === null ? null : arithInt(s.op.replace(/=$/, ''), a, c);
            return r === null ? null : { key: 'n:' + String(r), expr: intExpr(r) };
          }
          if (q < s.values.length)"""
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old="""// Values: number/string/boolean/nil literals, copies of tracked locals, and caller-declared"""
new="""// Values: number/string/boolean/nil literals, integer arithmetic over them (so the counter of an
// unrolled loop — `n = n + 1` / `n += 1` — stays a known constant), copies of tracked locals, and caller-declared"""
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok')

// Proto / function inventory — universal: nothing obfuscator- or sample-specific.
// The luac -l -l view of a script, recovered from source:
//   * every function — or, in a PRISM VM residual program (vm_lift / vm_specialize output: protos as
//     `T[n] = function(upvalues, …) … end` makers, closures made by `T[m](array)`), every proto;
//   * the constants each one uses: strings, numbers, globals and global paths (`string.format`), methods;
//   * its upvalues — free locals, or the upvalue array's slots and how each one is read (`k[1][157]`);
//   * the protos / functions it creates and, per creation site, what goes into each upvalue slot of the
//     new closure (a shared register box, a register value, one of the creator's own upvalues, any expression);
//   * the constant pools it fills (a table getting >= 8 literal-keyed stores of literals / global paths,
//     or a table constructor of >= 8 constant fields);
//   * the creation tree, and what every proto has in common (the VM's own scaffolding).
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes } from './scope.js';
import type { Binding } from './scope.js';
import { printExpr } from '../vm/specialize.js';

export interface InvCapture { slot: string; kind: 'box' | 'value' | 'upvalue' | 'expr'; register?: number; upvalue?: string; text: string }
export interface InvChild { id: string; line: number; captures: InvCapture[] }
export interface InvUpvalue { name: string; reads: number; writes: number; fields: Array<[string, number]> }
export interface InvPool { name: string; line: number; entries: Array<[string, string]> }
export interface InvUnit {
  id: string; name: string; line: number; endLine: number; header?: string;
  params: string[]; vararg: boolean; parents: string[];
  /** [value, uses] in first-use order */
  strings: Array<[string, number]>; numbers: Array<[string, number]>; globals: Array<[string, number]>; methods: Array<[string, number]>;
  upvalues: InvUpvalue[]; children: InvChild[]; pools: InvPool[]; calls: number;
  /** register table name (VM protos: the local indexed most by integer literals) */
  registers?: string;
}
export interface Inventory {
  mode: 'protos' | 'functions';
  protoTable?: string;
  units: InvUnit[];
  /** used by every proto / function (when there are >= 4): the VM's own scaffolding */
  common: { globals: string[]; strings: string[]; upvalues: string[] };
  tree: string[];
  notes: string[];
}

const IDENT = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/;
type Ctx = { list: A.Stat[]; index: number } | null;
const keyText = (e: A.Expr | undefined): string | null =>
  !e ? null : e.type === 'NumberLit' ? String(e.value) : e.type === 'StringLit' ? JSON.stringify(e.value) : null;
const bump = (m: Map<string, number>, k: string) => m.set(k, (m.get(k) ?? 0) + 1);
const reEsc = (s: string) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

interface Work {
  u: InvUnit; fn: A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk; upParam?: Binding;
  strings: Map<string, number>; numbers: Map<string, number>; globals: Map<string, number>; methods: Map<string, number>;
  ups: Map<string, { reads: number; writes: number; fields: Map<string, number> }>;
  idx: Map<string, number>;
  poolCand: Map<Binding | A.TableExpr, { name: string; line: number; stores: number; consts: number; dup: number; entries: Map<string, string> }>;
}

/** the PRISM residual proto table: the table getting the most top-level `T[lit] = function … end` makers */
function findProtoTable(chunk: A.Chunk): { name: string; makers: Array<{ id: string; fn: A.FunctionExpr }> } | null {
  const by = new Map<string, Array<{ id: string; fn: A.FunctionExpr }>>();
  for (const s of chunk.body) {
    if (s.type !== 'AssignStat' || s.targets.length !== 1 || s.values.length !== 1 || s.op) continue;
    const t = s.targets[0], v = s.values[0];
    if (t.type !== 'IndexExpr' || t.obj.type !== 'NameExpr' || v.type !== 'FunctionExpr') continue;
    const id = keyText(t.index);
    if (id === null) continue;
    if (!by.has(t.obj.name)) by.set(t.obj.name, []);
    by.get(t.obj.name)!.push({ id: id.replace(/^"|"$/g, ''), fn: v });
  }
  let best: { name: string; makers: Array<{ id: string; fn: A.FunctionExpr }> } | null = null;
  for (const [name, makers] of by) if (makers.length >= 2 && (!best || makers.length > best.makers.length)) best = { name, makers };
  return best;
}

export function protoInventory(chunk: A.Chunk, src = ''): Inventory {
  const sc = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const srcLines = src ? src.split('\n') : [];
  const pt = findProtoTable(chunk);
  const mode: Inventory['mode'] = pt ? 'protos' : 'functions';
  const notes: string[] = [];
  const parentOf = new Map<object, [any, string | null]>();
  const fnWork = new Map<A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk, Work>();
  const works: Work[] = [];
  const lastLine = srcLines.length || 1;
  const newWork = (u: InvUnit, fn: A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk): Work => {
    const w: Work = { u, fn, strings: new Map(), numbers: new Map(), globals: new Map(), methods: new Map(), ups: new Map(), idx: new Map(), poolCand: new Map() };
    works.push(w);
    return w;
  };
  const unit = (id: string, name: string, f: A.FunctionExpr | null, line: number, endLine: number): InvUnit => ({
    id, name, line, endLine, params: f ? f.params : [], vararg: f ? f.vararg : true, parents: [],
    strings: [], numbers: [], globals: [], methods: [], upvalues: [], children: [], pools: [], calls: 0,
  });
  const main = newWork(unit('main', 'main chunk', null, 1, lastLine), chunk);
  fnWork.set(chunk, main);
  const makerWork = new Map<A.FunctionExpr, Work>();
  if (pt) {
    for (const m of pt.makers) {
      const line = m.fn.loc?.line ?? 0;
      const u = unit(m.id, 'proto ' + m.id, m.fn, line, m.fn.loc?.endLine ?? line);
      const h = line >= 2 ? srcLines[line - 2]?.trim() : undefined;
      if (h && h.startsWith('--')) u.header = h.replace(/^--+\s*/, '');
      const w = newWork(u, m.fn);
      const p0 = m.fn.params[0];
      if (p0) w.upParam = (sc.fnBindings.get(m.fn) ?? []).find(b => b.name === p0);
      makerWork.set(m.fn, w);
    }
  }
  const fnName = (f: A.FunctionExpr, parent: any, key: string | null): string => {
    if (parent?.type === 'LocalFunctionStat') return parent.name;
    if (parent?.type === 'FunctionStat') { const t = printExpr(parent.target); return parent.isMethod ? t.replace(/\.([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)$/, ':$1') : t; }
    if (parent?.type === 'AssignStat' && key === 'values') { const i = parent.values.indexOf(f); if (parent.targets[i]) return printExpr(parent.targets[i]); }
    if (parent?.type === 'LocalStat' && key === 'init') { const i = parent.init.indexOf(f); if (parent.names[i]) return parent.names[i]; }
    if (parent && !parent.type && parent.kind === 'named' && parent.name) return '.' + parent.name;
    return 'function';
  };
  const pending: Array<{ w: Work; call: A.CallExpr; ctx: Ctx; id: string }> = [];
  const pathRoot = (e: any, depth = 0): string | null => {
    if (depth > 6) return null;
    if (e.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = sc.refOf.get(e); return b && b.kind === 'global' && e.name !== pt?.name ? e.name : null; }
    if (e.type === 'MemberExpr') { const p = pathRoot(e.obj, depth + 1); return p ? p + '.' + e.name : null; }
    if (e.type === 'IndexExpr' && e.index.type === 'StringLit' && IDENT.test(e.index.value)) { const p = pathRoot(e.obj, depth + 1); return p ? p + '.' + e.index.value : null; }
    return null;
  };
  const constLike = (v: A.Expr): boolean =>
    v.type === 'NilLit' || v.type === 'TrueLit' || v.type === 'FalseLit' || v.type === 'NumberLit' || v.type === 'StringLit'
    || (v.type === 'UnExpr' && v.op === '-' && v.expr.type === 'NumberLit') || pathRoot(v) !== null;
  const upOf = (w: Work, name: string) => {
    let e = w.ups.get(name);
    if (!e) { e = { reads: 0, writes: 0, fields: new Map() }; w.ups.set(name, e); }
    return e;
  };
  const isWrite = (node: any) => { const p = parentOf.get(node); return !!p && p[0]?.type === 'AssignStat' && p[1] === 'targets'; };
  const fieldOf = (node: any): string | null => { const p = parentOf.get(node); return p && p[0]?.type === 'IndexExpr' && p[1] === 'obj' ? keyText(p[0].index) ?? '?' : null; };

  const onNode = (n: any, parent: any, key: string | null, w: Work, ctx: Ctx) => {
    switch (n.type) {
      case 'StringLit':
        if (parent?.type === 'IndexExpr' && key === 'index' && IDENT.test(n.value) && pathRoot(parent.obj)) break; // part of a global path
        bump(w.strings, n.value);
        break;
      case 'NumberLit':
        if ((parent?.type === 'IndexExpr' && key === 'index') || key === 'key') break; // table subscripts / keys
        bump(w.numbers, (parent?.type === 'UnExpr' && parent.op === '-' ? '-' : '') + String(n.value));
        break;
      case 'NameExpr': {
        const b = sc.refOf.get(n);
        if (!b) break;
        if (b.kind === 'global') {
          if (n.name === pt?.name) break;
          let top: any = n, path = n.name;
          for (let d = 1; d < 4; d++) {
            const p = parentOf.get(top);
            if (!p || p[1] !== 'obj') break;
            const par = p[0];
            if (par.type === 'MemberExpr') path += '.' + par.name;
            else if (par.type === 'IndexExpr' && par.index.type === 'StringLit' && IDENT.test(par.index.value)) path += '.' + par.index.value;
            else break;
            top = par;
          }
          bump(w.globals, path);
          break;
        }
        if (w.upParam && b === w.upParam) {
          const p = parentOf.get(n);
          if (p && p[0]?.type === 'IndexExpr' && p[1] === 'obj') {
            const slot = keyText(p[0].index) ?? '?';
            const e = upOf(w, `${n.name}[${slot}]`);
            if (isWrite(p[0])) e.writes++; else e.reads++;
            const f = fieldOf(p[0]);
            if (f !== null) bump(e.fields, f);
          } else upOf(w, n.name).reads++;
          break;
        }
        if (fnWork.get(b.fn) !== w && b.name !== pt?.name) {
          const e = upOf(w, b.name);
          if (isWrite(n)) e.writes++; else e.reads++;
          const f = fieldOf(n);
          if (f !== null) bump(e.fields, f);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'IndexExpr':
        if (n.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && n.index.type === 'NumberLit' && Number.isInteger(n.index.value)) bump(w.idx, n.obj.name);
        break;
      case 'CallExpr':
        w.u.calls++;
        if (pt && n.callee.type === 'IndexExpr' && n.callee.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && n.callee.obj.name === pt.name) {
          const id = keyText(n.callee.index);
          if (id !== null) pending.push({ w, call: n, ctx, id: id.replace(/^"|"$/g, '') });
        }
        break;
      case 'MethodCallExpr':
        w.u.calls++;
        bump(w.methods, n.method);
        break;
      case 'AssignStat':
        if (n.op || n.targets.length !== n.values.length) break;
        n.targets.forEach((t: A.Expr, i: number) => {
          if (t.type !== 'IndexExpr' || t.obj.type !== 'NameExpr') return;
          const k = keyText(t.index);
          const b = sc.refOf.get(t.obj);
          if (k === null || !b || b.kind === 'global') return;
          let pc = w.poolCand.get(b);
          if (!pc) { pc = { name: t.obj.name, line: n.loc?.line ?? 0, stores: 0, consts: 0, dup: 0, entries: new Map() }; w.poolCand.set(b, pc); }
          pc.stores++;
          const v = n.values[i];
          if (constLike(v)) { pc.consts++; if (pc.entries.has(k)) pc.dup++; pc.entries.set(k, printExpr(v)); }
        });
        break;
      case 'TableExpr': {
        if (n.fields.length < 8) break;
        const ent = new Map<string, string>();
        let item = 0, consts = 0;
        for (const f of n.fields as A.TableField[]) {
          const k = f.kind === 'item' ? String(++item) : f.kind === 'named' ? JSON.stringify(f.name) : keyText(f.key);
          if (k !== null && constLike(f.value)) { consts++; ent.set(k, printExpr(f.value)); }
        }
        if (consts < 8 || consts < 0.9 * n.fields.length) break;
        let name = 'table';
        if (parent?.type === 'LocalStat' && key === 'init') name = parent.names[parent.init.indexOf(n)] ?? name;
        else if (parent?.type === 'AssignStat' && key === 'values') { const t = parent.targets[parent.values.indexOf(n)]; if (t) name = printExpr(t); }
        w.poolCand.set(n, { name, line: n.loc?.line ?? 0, stores: consts, consts, dup: 0, entries: ent });
        break;
      }
    }
  };

  const visit = (node: any, parent: any, key: string | null, w: Work, ctx: Ctx) => {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
    if (typeof node.type === 'string') {
      parentOf.set(node, [parent, key]);
      if (node.type === 'FunctionExpr') {
        const mw = makerWork.get(node);
        if (mw) w = mw;
        else if (mode === 'functions') {
          const line = node.loc?.line ?? 0;
          const name = fnName(node, parent, key);
          const nw = newWork(unit(`${name}@${line}`, name, node, line, node.loc?.endLine ?? line), node);
          w.u.children.push({ id: nw.u.id, line, captures: [] });
          w = nw;
        }
        fnWork.set(node, w);
      }
      onNode(node, parent, key, w, ctx);
    }
    for (const k of Object.keys(node)) {
      if (k === 'loc' || k === 'type') continue;
      const v = node[k];
      if (Array.isArray(v)) {
        const list = k === 'body' || k === 'elseBody';
        for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) visit(v[i], node, k, w, list ? { list: v, index: i } : ctx);
      } else if (v && typeof v === 'object') visit(v, node, k, w, ctx);
    }
  };
  visit(chunk, null, null, main, null);

  // registers: the local each unit indexes most with integer literals (not its upvalue array)
  for (const w of works) {
    let best = '', bn = 0;
    for (const [name, c] of w.idx) if (c > bn && name !== w.upParam?.name) { best = name; bn = c; }
    if (bn >= 8) w.u.registers = best;
  }

  // closure creation sites: what goes into each upvalue slot of the new closure
  const assigns = (s: any, name: string) =>
    (s?.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op && s.targets.some((t: any) => t.type === 'NameExpr' && t.name === name))
    || (s?.type === 'LocalStat' && s.names.includes(name));
  for (const p of pending) {
    const caps = new Map<string, InvCapture>();
    const arg = p.call.args[0];
    const reg = p.w.u.registers;
    const upName = p.w.upParam?.name;
    const regRe = reg ? new RegExp('^' + reEsc(reg) + '_(\\d+)$') : null;
    const last = new Map<string, A.Expr>();
    const describe = (slot: string, v0: A.Expr): InvCapture => {
      let v = v0;
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      while (v.type === 'NameExpr' && last.has(v.name) && !seen.has(v.name) && !(regRe && regRe.test(v.name))) { seen.add(v.name); v = last.get(v.name)!; }
      if (v.type === 'TableExpr') {
        const num = v.fields.find(f => f.value.type === 'NumberLit');
        const tab = v.fields.find(f => f.value.type === 'NameExpr');
        if (num && tab) return { slot, kind: 'box', register: (num.value as A.NumberLit).value, text: printExpr(v) };
      }
      if (v.type === 'IndexExpr' && v.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && v.index.type === 'NumberLit') {
        if (upName && v.obj.name === upName) return { slot, kind: 'upvalue', upvalue: String(v.index.value), text: printExpr(v) };
        if (reg && v.obj.name === reg) return { slot, kind: 'value', register: v.index.value, text: printExpr(v) };
      }
      if (v.type === 'NameExpr' && regRe) { const m = regRe.exec(v.name); if (m) return { slot, kind: 'value', register: Number(m[1]), text: v.name }; }
      return { slot, kind: 'expr', text: printExpr(v) };
    };
    if (arg?.type === 'TableExpr') {
      let item = 0;
      for (const f of arg.fields) {
        const k = f.kind === 'item' ? String(++item) : f.kind === 'named' ? JSON.stringify(f.name) : keyText(f.key);
        if (k !== null) caps.set(k, describe(k, f.value));
      }
    } else if (arg?.type === 'NameExpr' && p.ctx) {
      const name = arg.name, L = p.ctx.list;
      let start = p.ctx.index, end = L.length - 1;
      for (let i = p.ctx.index - 1; i >= 0 && p.ctx.index - i <= 400; i--) if (assigns(L[i], name)) { start = i; break; }
      for (let i = p.ctx.index + 1; i < L.length; i++) if (assigns(L[i], name)) { end = i - 1; break; }
      const step = (s: any) => {
        switch (s?.type) {
          case 'LocalStat': s.names.forEach((nm: string, i: number) => { if (s.init[i]) last.set(nm, s.init[i]); else last.delete(nm); }); break;
          case 'AssignStat':
            if (s.op) break;
            s.targets.forEach((t: any, i: number) => {
              const v = s.values[i];
              if (!v) return;
              if (t.type === 'NameExpr') last.set(t.name, v);
              else if (t.type === 'IndexExpr' && t.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && t.obj.name === name) { const slot = keyText(t.index); if (slot !== null) caps.set(slot, describe(slot, v)); }
            });
            break;
          case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) c.body.forEach(step); if (s.elseBody) s.elseBody.forEach(step); break;
          case 'DoStat': s.body.forEach(step); break;
        }
      };
      for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) step(L[i]);
    }
    const sorted = [...caps.values()].sort((a, b) => (Number(a.slot) - Number(b.slot)) || (a.slot < b.slot ? -1 : a.slot > b.slot ? 1 : 0));
    p.w.u.children.push({ id: p.id, line: p.call.loc?.line ?? 0, captures: sorted });
  }

  // finish units
  for (const w of works) {
    const u = w.u;
    u.strings = [...w.strings]; u.numbers = [...w.numbers]; u.globals = [...w.globals]; u.methods = [...w.methods];
    u.upvalues = [...w.ups].map(([name, e]) => ({ name, reads: e.reads, writes: e.writes, fields: [...e.fields] }));
    for (const pc of w.poolCand.values()) {
      if (pc.entries.size >= 8 && pc.consts >= 0.9 * pc.stores && pc.dup <= 0.1 * pc.consts) u.pools.push({ name: pc.name, line: pc.line, entries: [...pc.entries] });
    }
  }
  const units = works.map(w => w.u);
  if (mode === 'protos') units.sort((a, b) => (a.id === 'main' ? -1 : b.id === 'main' ? 1 : a.line - b.line));
  const byId = new Map(units.map(u => [u.id, u]));
  for (const u of units) for (const c of u.children) { const cu = byId.get(c.id); if (cu && !cu.parents.includes(u.id)) cu.parents.push(u.id); }
  const missing = new Set<string>();
  for (const u of units) for (const c of u.children) if (!byId.has(c.id)) missing.add(c.id);
  if (missing.size) notes.push(`created but not defined here: ${[...missing].join(', ')}`);

  // what every proto / function has in common — the VM's own scaffolding
  const rest = units.filter(u => u.id !== 'main');
  const common = { globals: [] as string[], strings: [] as string[], upvalues: [] as string[] };
  if (rest.length >= 4) {
    const all = (pick: (u: InvUnit) => string[]) => { const [f, ...o] = rest.map(u => new Set(pick(u))); return [...(f ?? [])].filter(x => o.every(s => s.has(x))); };
    common.globals = all(u => u.globals.map(g => g[0]));
    common.strings = all(u => u.strings.map(s => s[0]));
    common.upvalues = all(u => u.upvalues.map(x => x.name).filter(n => !/\[/.test(n)));
  }

  // creation tree
  const tree: string[] = [];
  const shown = new Set<string>();
  const label = (u: InvUnit, times: number) => {
    const ins = /(\d+) instructions?/.exec(u.header ?? '')?.[1];
    const caps = u.parents.length ? '' : '';
    return `${u.name}${ins ? `  (${ins} instr)` : ''}${times > 1 ? `  ×${times}` : ''}${caps}`;
  };
  const dfs = (u: InvUnit, prefix: string, last: boolean, times: number, depth: number) => {
    const again = shown.has(u.id);
    tree.push(`${prefix}${depth ? (last ? '└─ ' : '├─ ') : ''}${label(u, times)}${again ? '  (see above)' : ''}`);
    if (again) return;
    shown.add(u.id);
    const kids = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const c of u.children) if (byId.has(c.id)) kids.set(c.id, (kids.get(c.id) ?? 0) + 1);
    const ks = [...kids];
    ks.forEach(([id, n], i) => dfs(byId.get(id)!, prefix + (depth ? (last ? '   ' : '│  ') : ''), i === ks.length - 1, n, depth + 1));
  };
  for (const u of units) if (!u.parents.length) dfs(u, '', true, 1, 0);
  for (const u of units) if (!shown.has(u.id)) dfs(u, '', true, 1, 0); // creation cycles
  return { mode, protoTable: pt?.name, units, common, tree, notes };
}

const q = (s: string, n = 60) => { const j = JSON.stringify(s); return j.length > n ? j.slice(0, n - 1) + '…"' : j; };
const list = (xs: string[], max: number) => xs.length <= max ? xs.join(', ') : xs.slice(0, max).join(', ') + `, … +${xs.length - max} more`;
const counted = (xs: Array<[string, number]>, fmt: (s: string) => string, max: number) => list(xs.map(([s, n]) => fmt(s) + (n > 1 ? ` ×${n}` : '')), max);

export function formatCapture(c: InvCapture): string {
  if (c.kind === 'box') return `${c.slot}=box r${c.register}`;
  if (c.kind === 'value') return `${c.slot}=r${c.register}`;
  if (c.kind === 'upvalue') return `${c.slot}=upvalue ${c.upvalue}`;
  return `${c.slot}=${c.text.length > 40 ? c.text.slice(0, 39) + '…' : c.text}`;
}

/** readable inventory: tree, scaffolding, then one section per proto / function */
export function formatInventory(inv: Inventory, o: { max?: number; only?: string[] } = {}): string {
  const max = o.max ?? 60;
  const out: string[] = [];
  const n = inv.units.filter(u => u.id !== 'main').length;
  out.push(inv.mode === 'protos'
    ? `# proto inventory — ${n} proto(s) of a VM residual program (${inv.protoTable}[n] makers; closures made by ${inv.protoTable}[m](upvalues))`
    : `# function inventory — main chunk + ${n} function(s)`);
  out.push('', 'creation tree:', ...inv.tree);
  const cg = new Set(inv.common.globals), cs = new Set(inv.common.strings), cu = new Set(inv.common.upvalues);
  if (cg.size || cs.size || cu.size) {
    out.push('', `common to every ${inv.mode === 'protos' ? 'proto' : 'function'} (scaffolding — not repeated below):`);
    if (cg.size) out.push(`  globals: ${list([...cg], max)}`);
    if (cu.size) out.push(`  free locals: ${list([...cu], max)}`);
    if (cs.size) out.push(`  strings: ${list([...cs].map(s => q(s)), max)}`);
  }
  for (const w of inv.notes) out.push('# ' + w);
  const only = o.only?.length ? new Set(o.only) : null;
  for (const u of inv.units) {
    if (only && !only.has(u.id) && !only.has(u.name)) continue;
    const own = u.id === 'main';
    out.push('', `## ${u.name}${u.header ? ' — ' + u.header.replace(/^proto \S+:\s*/, '') : ''} — lines ${u.line}–${u.endLine}${u.parents.length ? ' — created by ' + u.parents.map(p => p === 'main' ? 'main' : (inv.mode === 'protos' ? 'proto ' + p : p)).join(', ') : ''}`);
    if (!own && inv.mode === 'functions') out.push(`params: (${[...u.params, ...(u.vararg ? ['...'] : [])].join(', ')})`);
    const ups = u.upvalues.filter(x => !cu.has(x.name));
    const slots = ups.filter(x => /\[/.test(x.name)), free = ups.filter(x => !/\[/.test(x.name));
    const upText = (x: InvUpvalue) => `${x.name}${x.reads + x.writes > 1 ? ` ×${x.reads + x.writes}` : ''}${x.writes ? ` (${x.writes} write${x.writes > 1 ? 's' : ''})` : ''}${x.fields.length ? ` [fields ${list(x.fields.map(([f, c]) => f + (c > 1 ? '×' + c : '')), 12)}]` : ''}`;
    if (inv.mode === 'protos' && !own) out.push(`upvalues read: ${slots.length ? list(slots.map(upText), max) : 'none'}`);
    if (free.length) out.push(`${inv.mode === 'protos' ? 'locals of the residual program used' : 'upvalues (free locals)'}: ${list(free.map(upText), max)}`);
    if (u.children.length) {
      out.push(`creates (${u.children.length}):`);
      for (const c of u.children.slice(0, max)) out.push(`  ${inv.mode === 'protos' ? 'proto ' + c.id : c.id} @${c.line}${c.captures.length ? ` — upvalues ${list(c.captures.map(formatCapture), 40)}` : ''}`);
      if (u.children.length > max) out.push(`  … +${u.children.length - max} more`);
    }
    for (const p of u.pools.slice(0, own ? 3 : 20)) out.push(`constant pool ${p.name} @${p.line}: ${p.entries.length} entries — ${list(p.entries.map(([k, v]) => `[${k}]=${v.length > 30 ? v.slice(0, 29) + '…' : v}`), own ? 8 : max)}`);
    if (u.pools.length > (own ? 3 : 20)) out.push(`  … +${u.pools.length - (own ? 3 : 20)} more constant pools`);
    const g = u.globals.filter(x => !cg.has(x[0])), s = u.strings.filter(x => !cs.has(x[0]));
    if (g.length) out.push(`globals (${g.length}): ${counted(g, x => x, max)}`);
    if (u.methods.length) out.push(`methods (${u.methods.length}): ${counted(u.methods, x => ':' + x, max)}`);
    if (s.length) out.push(`strings (${s.length}): ${counted(s, x => q(x), max)}`);
    if (u.numbers.length) out.push(`numbers (${u.numbers.length}): ${counted(u.numbers, x => x, max)}`);
    out.push(`calls: ${u.calls}`);
  }
  return out.join('\n');
}
EOF

Write known-truthy folding pass
cd /data/prism/packages/core/src && grep -n 'promoted?: number\|multret?: number' index.ts | head -3 && cat > passes/truthy.ts <<'EOF'
// Known-truthy operands \u2014 universal, sound.
//
//   for i = 106, top do R[i] = v[i - 105] end       for i = 106, top do R[i] = v[i - 105] end
//   f(table.unpack(R, 104, top or #R))         ->   f(table.unpack(R, 104, top))
//
// A local is known truthy (neither nil nor false) where every path to the use passes a definition that
// cannot give nil / false \u2014 a number or string literal, `true`, a table or function constructor, another
// known-truthy local \u2014 or a numeric for loop that has the local as a bound (the loop raises an error on a
// nil / false bound), with no write of the local in between. There `x or y` becomes `x` and `x and y`
// becomes `y`. Forward must-analysis over the structured statements: branches meet by intersection, loop
// bodies only keep facts about locals they never write, labels reset everything, locals written by nested
// closures are never tracked. (VM residuals use `top or #R` as the multiple-results bound; dropping the dead
// `#R` lets the register file be promoted.)
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding } from '../analysis/scope.js';

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = (e as A.ParenExpr).expr; return e; };
const isMulti = (e: A.Expr | undefined) => !!e && (e.type === 'CallExpr' || e.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || e.type === 'VarargLit');
const TERMINAL = new Set(['ReturnStat', 'BreakStat', 'ContinueStat', 'GotoStat']);
type S = Set<Binding>;

export function foldKnownTruthy(chunk: A.Chunk): number {
  const sc = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const declB = new Map<unknown, Binding[]>();
  for (const b of sc.bindings) if (b.decl) { const l = declB.get(b.decl); if (l) l.push(b); else declB.set(b.decl, [b]); }
  const tracked = (b: Binding | undefined): b is Binding => !!b && b.kind !== 'global' && !b.capturedWrite;
  const bindingOf = (e: A.Expr | undefined): Binding | undefined => { const u = e && unparen(e); return u && u.type === 'NameExpr' ? sc.refOf.get(u as A.NameExpr) : undefined; };
  let n = 0;

  const truthy = (e: A.Expr | undefined, s: S): boolean => {
    if (!e) return false;
    const u = unparen(e);
    switch (u.type) {
      case 'NumberLit': case 'StringLit': case 'TrueLit': case 'TableExpr': case 'FunctionExpr': return true;
      case 'NameExpr': { const b = sc.refOf.get(u as A.NameExpr); return !!b && s.has(b); }
      default: return false;
    }
  };
  // rewrite the expressions evaluated at this point (nested functions get their own, empty state)
  const rw = (node: any, s: S): any => {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return node;
    if (Array.isArray(node)) { for (let i = 0; i < node.length; i++) node[i] = rw(node[i], s); return node; }
    if (node.type === 'FunctionExpr') { block(node.body, new Set()); return node; }
    for (const k of Object.keys(node)) {
      if (k === 'loc' || k === 'type') continue;
      const v = node[k];
      if (v && typeof v === 'object') node[k] = rw(v, s);
    }
    if (node.type === 'BinExpr' && (node.op === 'or' || node.op === 'and') && truthy(node.left, s)) { n++; return node.op === 'or' ? node.left : node.right; }
    return node;
  };
  const writesIn = (root: any): Set<Binding> => {
    const w = new Set<Binding>();
    const visit = (node: any) => {
      if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(node)) { for (const x of node) visit(x); return; }
      if (node.type === 'AssignStat') for (const t of node.targets) { const b = bindingOf(t); if (b) w.add(b); }
      if (node.type === 'FunctionStat') { const b = bindingOf(node.target); if (b) w.add(b); }
      for (const k of Object.keys(node)) if (k !== 'loc' && k !== 'type') visit(node[k]);
    };
    visit(root);
    return w;
  };
  const minus = (s: S, w: Set<Binding>): S => { const r = new Set(s); for (const b of w) r.delete(b); return r; };
  const assignTo = (b: Binding | undefined, value: A.Expr | undefined, single: boolean, s: S, before: S) => {
    if (!tracked(b)) return;
    if (single && truthy(value, before)) s.add(b); else s.delete(b);
  };
  const replace = (s: S, by: S) => { s.clear(); for (const b of by) s.add(b); };

  function block(list: A.Stat[], s: S) { for (const st of list) stat(st, s); }
  function stat(st: A.Stat, s: S) {
    const x = st as any;
    switch (st.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': {
        rw(x.init, s);
        const before = new Set(s);
        const bs = declB.get(st) ?? [];
        for (const b of bs) assignTo(b, x.init[b.index], b.index < x.init.length && !(b.index === x.init.length - 1 && isMulti(x.init[b.index]) && x.names.length > x.init.length) && !(b.index >= x.init.length - 1 && isMulti(x.init[x.init.length - 1]) && b.index > x.init.length - 1), s, before);
        return;
      }
      case 'AssignStat': {
        rw(x.values, s);
        for (const t of x.targets) if (unparen(t).type !== 'NameExpr') rw(t, s);
        const before = new Set(s);
        x.targets.forEach((t: A.Expr, i: number) => {
          const b = bindingOf(t);
          if (x.op) { if (tracked(b)) s.delete(b); return; }
          assignTo(b, x.values[i], i < x.values.length, s, before);
        });
        return;
      }
      case 'CallStat': case 'ReturnStat': rw(st, s); return;
      case 'DoStat': block(x.body, s); return;
      case 'IfStat': {
        const outs: S[] = [];
        for (const c of x.clauses) {
          c.cond = rw(c.cond, s);
          const cs = new Set(s); block(c.body, cs);
          if (!c.body.length || !TERMINAL.has(c.body[c.body.length - 1].type)) outs.push(cs);
        }
        if (x.elseBody) { const cs = new Set(s); block(x.elseBody, cs); if (!x.elseBody.length || !TERMINAL.has(x.elseBody[x.elseBody.length - 1].type)) outs.push(cs); }
        else outs.push(new Set(s));
        if (!outs.length) return;
        const inter = new Set([...outs[0]].filter(b => outs.every(o => o.has(b))));
        replace(s, inter);
        return;
      }
      case 'WhileStat': {
        const e = minus(s, writesIn(x.body));
        x.cond = rw(x.cond, e);
        block(x.body, new Set(e));
        replace(s, e);
        return;
      }
      case 'RepeatStat': {
        const e = minus(s, writesIn(x.body));
        block(x.body, new Set(e));
        x.cond = rw(x.cond, e);
        replace(s, e);
        return;
      }
      case 'NumericForStat': {
        x.from = rw(x.from, s); x.to = rw(x.to, s); if (x.step) x.step = rw(x.step, s);
        for (const bound of [x.from, x.to, x.step]) { const b = bindingOf(bound); if (tracked(b)) s.add(b); }
        const e = minus(s, writesIn(x.body));
        block(x.body, new Set(e));
        replace(s, e);
        return;
      }
      case 'GenericForStat': {
        rw(x.iters, s);
        const e = minus(s, writesIn(x.body));
        block(x.body, new Set(e));
        replace(s, e);
        return;
      }
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': {
        block(x.func.body, new Set());
        for (const b of declB.get(st) ?? []) if (tracked(b)) s.add(b);
        return;
      }
      case 'FunctionStat': {
        block(x.func.body, new Set());
        if (x.target && unparen(x.target).type !== 'NameExpr') rw(x.target, s);
        const b = bindingOf(x.target);
        if (tracked(b)) s.add(b);
        return;
      }
      case 'BreakStat': case 'ContinueStat': return;
      default:
        // labels (goto targets) and anything unknown: forget everything
        s.clear();
        return;
    }
  }
  block(chunk.body, new Set());
  return n;
}
EOF

rep("    if (o.packHelper) { const m = fuseMultret(chunk, { isPack: o.packHelper });", "    if (o.propagate || o.promoteRegisters || o.packHelper) { const t = foldKnownTruthy(chunk); if (t) { stats.truthyFolded = (stats.truthyFolded ?? 0) + t; changed += t; } }\n    if (o.packHelper) { const m = fuseMultret(chunk, { isPack: o.packHelper });")

rep("""  const isState = (name: string) => {
    const g = sc.globals.get(name), st = gstat.get(name);
    return (!!g && g.writes > 0) || (!!st && st.int > 0 && st.other === 0);
  };""", """  const baseState = (name: string) => {
    const g = sc.globals.get(name), st = gstat.get(name);
    return (!!g && g.writes > 0) || (!!st && st.int > 0 && st.other === 0);
  };
  // numbered families (K_12, K_16, K_249, \u2026): generated names \u2014 when 3+ members exist and one of them is
  // program state, the whole family is (members used only as values are not API globals either)
  const famOf = (name: string) => /^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*?)_(\\d+)$/.exec(name)?.[1];
  const fam = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const name of sc.globals.keys()) { const f = famOf(name); if (f !== undefined) { const l = fam.get(f); if (l) l.push(name); else fam.set(f, [name]); } }
  const stateFam = new Set<string>();
  for (const [f, names] of fam) if (names.length >= 3 && names.some(baseState)) stateFam.add(f);
  const isState = (name: string) => { if (baseState(name)) return true; const f = famOf(name); return f !== undefined && stateFam.has(f); };""")
